description: GET /api/v3/pass/{identifier} — single per-pass runtime artifact. This is the BACKFILL source for V3 CREATE's missing barcodeValue: for useAutoIdForValue=true templates, the auto-generated ID lives at `data.generatedId` (note: SINGULAR here vs `autoGeneratedId` in LIST). The CREATE response returns barcodeValue as a placeholder for these templates; the single-pass GET exposes the real value via generatedId.

backfillExtraction.rationale: For useAutoIdForValue=true templates, this field IS the per-pass barcode rendered on the wallet pass. Passcreator dashboard shows it as 'Barcode: zbood1tvxrvl31kv9e6ad3ef2f71561' for this identifier. The `barcodeValue` field is absent from single-pass GET response (no error — just missing).
